reserveReview.rationale: Exhibit B records $100,413,388 cash, $2,155,290,000 Treasury-collateralized reverse repos and $499,005,972 Treasury bills, totaling $2,754,709,360 at September 30, 2026, 5:00 PM Eastern Time. Independently reproduced amount / total * 100 yields 3.645153621578%, 78.240195909452% and 18.114650468970%; ordinary two-decimal rounding gives 3.65%, 78.24% and 18.11% (100.00%). No government money-market funds were held. All repos mature October 1, one day after the observation; the latest Treasury bill maturity is November 5, 36 days after period end. The repo category keeps a one-day maximum maturity, and Treasury bills keep the conservative 93-day ceiling from the report's statement that Paxos only holds Treasury bills three months or less from maturity; that is a category restriction, not the observed portfolio maximum or WAM. Exhibit A adds a Stable chain column (249,982 tokens). Individual counterparties remain anonymized; existing risk categories and liquidity horizons are unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of PYUSD Redemption Assets Report, Exhibit B as of September 30, 2026 at 5:00 PM Eastern Time; disclosed USD amounts independently divided by disclosed total redemption assets

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KPMG-examined report establishes segregated, unencumbered redemption assets held on behalf of PYUSD token holders by Paxos Trust Company, N.A., an OCC-supervised national trust bank, and prohibits selling or repledging the securities collateralizing the repo agreements. The Paxos USD Stablecoin Terms (last modified June 30, 2026, section 3.2.3.1) state that assets held with Paxos Trust are held bankruptcy remote and would not be used to satisfy Paxos Trust debts in insolvency; that fiduciary custody structure supports the structured bankruptcy-remoteness grade. Individual banks, the qualified custodian, and repo counterparties are not named, per-account placement is not published, and rehypothecation terms for cash deposits are not established, so the mixed cash and repo envelope stays conditional.
